records.name: examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_compound_impossible.lit
records.source:
# Stmt: By.ByContraStmt -> compound closing with two checked proofs
# Run: litex -strict -f examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_compound_impossible.lit
# Before the authorized closing-field change, this tail failed to parse:
# by contra:
#     ? not exist x {0} st {x = 1}
#     impossible exist x {0} st {x = 1}
# This requires the checked negative-existence background below.
# Quantifiers nested in forall/iff premises or conclusions remain unsupported.

by enumerate finite_set:
    ? forall x {0}:
        x != 1
by contra:
    ? not exist x {0} st {x = 1}
    obtain a from exist x {0} st {x = 1}
    a != 1
    impossible a = 1

by contra:
    ? not exist x {0} st {x = 1}
    impossible exist y {0} st {y = 1}
not exist x {0} st {x = 1}

forall x {0}:
    x = 0
by contra:
    ? forall n {0}:
        n = 0
    impossible forall q {0}:
        q = 0
forall n {0}:
    n = 0

proof_method.message: Prove by enumerating a finite set
Verified as an exist fact (details omitted in Normal)
Verified as a forall fact (details omitted in Normal)
Verified as a forall fact (details omitted in Normal)

records.name: examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_classified_goals.lit
records.source:
# Classified by-contra goals; no unified NotFact.
# Before: K005's negative-existence target rejected before its proof body.
# Run: target/release/litex -strict -f examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_classified_goals.lit
# Formerly rejected target, with the checked enumeration prefix:
# by contra:
#     ? not exist x {0} st {x = 1}
#     obtain a from exist x {0} st {x = 1}
#     a != 1
#     impossible a = 1
# Boundary: impossible remains atomic; exist! and quantified forall bodies
# still require additional classified negation constructions.

by enumerate finite_set:
    ? forall x {0}:
        x != 1
by contra:
    ? not exist x {0} st {x = 1}
    obtain a from exist x {0} st {x = 1}
    a != 1
    impossible a = 1

by contra:
    ? exist x {0} st {x = 0}
    impossible 0 = 0

by contra:
    ? 1 = 1 or 0 = 1
    impossible 1 != 1

by contra:
    ? not forall n {0}:
        n = 1
    impossible 0 = 1

forall z {0}:
    z = 0
by contra:
    ? forall n {0}:
        n = 0
    obtain b from exist m {0} st {m != 0}
    b = 0
    impossible b != 0

# Whole-body negation is a disjunction of counterexample conditions.
witness exist n {0} st {n != 0 or n != 1} from 0
not forall n {0}:
    n = 0
    n = 1

by contra:
    ? 1 = 1 and 0 = 0
    by cases:
        ? 0 = 1
        case 1 != 1:
            impossible 1 != 1
        case 0 != 0:
            impossible 0 != 0
    impossible 0 = 1

by contra:
    ? 0 <= 1 <= 2
    by cases:
        ? 0 = 1
        case not 0 <= 1:
            impossible not 0 <= 1
        case not 1 <= 2:
            impossible not 1 <= 2
    impossible 0 = 1

# Existing separated counterexample clauses remain usable.
witness exist x {0} st {x != 1 or x != 2, x != 3 or x != 4} from 0
not forall x {0}:
    x = 1 and x = 2 or x = 3 and x = 4

examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_forall_iff.lit
records.source:
# Contra checks the whole iff through existing QF + Exist shapes.
# Formerly rejected by the multiline goal parser:
# by contra:
#     ? forall x {0}:
#         =>:
#             0 = 0
#         <=>:
#             0 = 0
#     impossible 0 != 0
# Run: target/release/litex -strict -f examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_forall_iff.lit
# Boundary: quantified iff clauses exceed the current QF counterexample body.

by contra:
    ? forall x {0}:
        =>:
            0 = 0
        <=>:
            0 = 0
    obtain a from exist y {0} st {0 != 0 or 0 != 0, 0 = 0 or 0 = 0}
    by cases:
        ? 0 != 0
        case 0 != 0
        case 0 != 0
    impossible 0 != 0

records.name: examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_imaginary_unit.lit
records.source:
# Authoring control for the same imaginary-unit target.
# Historical route is nondeterministic in the existing kernel:
# by contra:
#     ? i != 0
#     i * i = -1
#     impossible i * i != 0
# Run: target/release/litex -strict -f examples/stmt_nodes/by/by_contra_imaginary_unit.lit
# The direct closing passes the recorded repeated controls; it does not
# repair the historical route. See the ByContraStmt issue folder.

by contra:
    ? i != 0
    impossible i = 0
